lessons_used: sign_in, copy changes were consistently helpful, winning 3 out of 4 tests (+2.2% average after noise correction).
adoption, redesign changes generally worked, winning 2 out of 3 tests (+3.3% average after noise correction).
home, wait_info changes consistently showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
home, new_flow changes consistently failed to show positive impact across 2 tests.
finish, new_screen changes generally failed to show positive results after an initial win, with recent tests performing worse.
Predictions were generally too high overall compared to noise-corrected results, and evidence remains thin for categories with only 1 test.

candidates.title: Primary Account Sign-In Guidance Copy
candidates.change: Update sign_in screen headline and body text to instruct users to sign in with their primary account to preserve pet data.
candidates.why: 8 support tickets cited missing or reset pets after signing in again, indicating users log in with alternate accounts.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Your Primary Account
sign_in.body: Use the exact same email or social sign-in you used previously to keep your pets and progress intact.

guard.reason: text in 'sign_in.body' asks for or mentions personal data

candidates.title: Split Layout Pet Selection Screen
candidates.change: Redesign pick_friend screen using a split layout featuring live companion previews alongside interactive choice cards.
candidates.why: Adoption step has the highest drop-off (29.7%) and redesign changes in adoption have proven effective (+3.3% average).
candidates.score_note: Adoption has the highest drop-off rate (29.7%) and adoption redesigns have a strong track record (+3.3% avg).

candidates.title: Multi-Account Social Sign-In Hint
candidates.change: Add an explicit hint on the sign_in screen clarifying that separate sign-in methods create independent pet profiles.
candidates.why: Support received 8 reports of missing pets caused by signing in with different social auth providers.

sign_in.hint: Note: Signing in with Google vs Apple creates separate accounts. Choose your original sign-in method.

guard.reason: Valid hint added to sign_in screen.

candidates.score_note: Strong support evidence (8 reports) combined with strong historical performance for sign_in hints/copy.

candidates.title: Custom Pet Confirmation Review Screen
candidates.change: Insert a new confirmation screen before the adoption certificate to let users review pet traits before creation.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected pet appearance during adoption.

new_pet_confirm.headline: Confirm Your Pet's Looks & Traits
new_pet_confirm.body: Review your pet choices before final creation. You can adjust photos or personality options now.

guard.reason: Valid new confirmation screen added within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: High friction step and support reports, but introducing new screens historically hurts completion (-1.3%).

candidates.title: Essential Desktop Controls Checklist Layout
candidates.change: Change home_intro layout to a checklist format highlighting core mouse and shortcut commands for desktop interaction.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets indicated post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the desktop pet.

home_intro.headline: Essential Desktop Pet Controls
home_intro.body: Try these basic controls: Right-click pet for main menu, double-click to chat, drag to reposition on screen.

guard.reason: Valid layout update for home_intro overlay.

candidates.score_note: Addresses support complaints on desktop control, but layout changes on finish have uncertain or weak lift.

candidates.title: Spotlight Choice Path Selection Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign choose_path screen using a spotlight layout with structured choice cards to compare onboarding paths.
candidates.why: choose_path has a 23.2% drop-off rate and a high mean completion time of 514s, indicating path selection friction.
candidates.score_note: Targets high completion time (514s) and 23.2% drop-off; redesigns generally perform well.

candidates.title: Photo Preparation Quality Checklist Flow
candidates.change: Add a photo verification checklist and picker flow on upload_photos to guide custom pet image selection.
candidates.why: 3 support reports cited custom pet generation errors and incorrect output caused by poor input photos.

guard.reason: Valid flow addition to upload_photos screen.

candidates.score_note: Supported by 3 tickets, but new_flow changes have consistently failed in past tests (-2.6%).

candidates.title: Desktop Tray & Account Control Hint
candidates.change: Add a hint to home_intro explaining how to access account settings and privacy options from the desktop tray icon.
candidates.why: Support received 4 emails after onboarding asking how to manage account settings and delete personal data.

home_intro.hint: Tip: Manage account settings, privacy options, and pet data anytime via the desktop tray icon menu.

guard.reason: Valid hint added to home_intro overlay.

candidates.score_note: Low-cost hint backed by 4 support emails; hint changes generally produce modest positive results.

candidates.title: Streamlined Story Intro Copy
candidates.change: Shorten story intro text to provide quick setup expectations before path selection.
candidates.why: choose_path step has a mean duration of 514s, suggesting users spend unnecessary time reading long intro text.

story.headline: Welcome to Your Virtual Desktop Companion
story.body: In just a few simple steps, pick or create your pet to keep you company on your desktop screen.

guard.reason: Valid copy update for story screen.

candidates.score_note: Targeted at 514s duration, but choose_path copy changes performed poorly in prior testing (-7.7%).

candidates.title: Desktop Ready System Notification
candidates.change: Enable desktop completion notification on waiting screen to alert users when pet loading finishes.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported pet failing to show on desktop or app appearing frozen during the initial launch wait.

waiting.body: Your pet is loading onto your desktop. We'll send a system alert the moment it arrives!

guard.reason: Valid notification setting added to waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Backed by 3 support tickets, but notification changes have consistently shown negative impact.

lessons_next: sign_in, copy changes were consistently helpful, winning 3 out of 4 tests (+2.2% average after noise correction).
adoption, redesign changes were helpful in 2 out of 4 tests (+2.3% average after noise correction), while the remaining 2 showed no clear effect.
home, wait_info, home, notification, and sign_in, hint changes consistently showed no clear effect across 2 tests each.
home, new_flow changes consistently failed to show positive impact across 2 tests, resulting in no clear effect or worse performance.
finish, new_screen changes generally failed after an initial win, with recent tests performing worse.
Predictions remained generally too high compared to noise-corrected results, and evidence remains thin for categories with only 1 test.
